title: Toing's Pops 2
description:
Inside the back rooms of the Toing's Pops candy store in Baltimore, a portal appears. Shining a familiar colour, Bink curiously enters. Through the portal lies an instance of isolation, power, torment, and knowledge. Become empowered, enlightened and isolated to help a particularly knowledgeable friend cheat death.

MEET THE CEO

Meet Chardonnay Hotrod in Toing's Pops 2's Campaign. Chardonnay Hotrod is the CEO of Toing's Pops, and of something else. It goes much deeper than you thought. Learn the horrifying truth, and attempt to stop it.

BOSS FIGHTS

Fight your way to Chardonnay, face him, and stop him. But to get to him, you'll have to face someone else first...

Run, Climb, Slide, and Crawl Your Way to Safety!
Toing's Pops 2 introduces new movement to bring a fast pace, and exciting experience to the game. Use these to your advantage in your attempt to save yourself and your friend.
description_short: Toing's Pops 2 is a singleplayer adventure horror game. Save your friend from his isolation while unlocking the secrets to Chardonnay's plans. Become empowered, and prepare to end this all.
